title: Reunion Committee Hub
tagline: A year of volunteer event planning in one self-contained page.
description: A single-page planning hub for a volunteer committee running a club's 50th anniversary reunion: meetups, budget, phone banking, marketing, emails and meeting notes in one place.
longDescription:
A volunteer committee organizing a 50th anniversary reunion has a year of scattered work: regional meetups, budgets, alumni phone banking, marketing assets, email campaigns and meeting notes. This hub puts all of it in one page.

- **Home** shows KPI cards, a countdown to the next event and a heat map of where alumni live (city-level counts only, no names).
- **Updates** lets members post progress with a status, and each post appears on Home, in the subcommittee table and on the linked event.
- **Meetings** keeps searchable summaries with decisions, owners and a list of items still open across meetings.
- **Events** gives each event an editable card with a six-step planning checklist.
- **Budget** tracks estimated vs. actual spend and includes a ticket planner that works out the break-even price.
- **Marketing** and **Alumni Emails** hold the brand kit and a shared log of every email sent.

### How it's built

It's one HTML file with no build step and no external requests: d3, TopoJSON, the US map and the fonts are all embedded. Tabs use hash routing in vanilla JavaScript. In production it runs as a Claude artifact on a shared realtime store; this demo swaps in a `localStorage` store with the same interface, so the app code is unchanged.

> Demo data only. "Harbor City Women's Rugby" and everyone in it are fictional.

tourSteps.title: The whole year at a glance
tourSteps.body: KPI cards and a countdown to the next event give the committee one place to check where things stand.

tourSteps.title: Where alumni live
tourSteps.body: A d3 heat map of alumni by city. It uses **counts only, no names**, so it's safe to share with every volunteer.

tourSteps.title: Updates flow everywhere
tourSteps.body: A post on the **Updates** tab shows up here, in the subcommittee table and on the linked event card at the same time.

tourSteps.title: Break-even ticket planner
tourSteps.body: Open the **Budget** tab: line items per event, spend by category, and a planner that calculates the break-even ticket price. Exports to CSV.

tourSteps.title: Try editing anything
tourSteps.body: Every field is editable and saved in your browser. **Reset demo data** puts the sample data back.
